source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 小区禁止新能源汽车进地库 律师解读
topics.official_english: Communities ban new-energy vehicles from underground garages: lawyers explain
topics.why_hot: A property rule against new-energy vehicles entering underground parking is being widely debated over charging access, fire safety and residents' rights.
topics.share_angle: Explain both sides: how cities are balancing EV charging convenience with underground garage fire risks, and what residents should know about property rules.

topics.chinese_topic: 女子怀孕后工资从8000调到3000
topics.official_english: Woman's salary cut from 8,000 to 3,000 yuan after pregnancy
topics.why_hot: A reported case of a pregnant woman's pay being cut by more than half has stirred anger and questions about legal protections for expectant mothers.
topics.share_angle: Break down China's labor protections for pregnant employees, what counts as unlawful pay discrimination, and where people can report such issues.

topics.chinese_topic: 人民日报：劳动教育岂能“代劳”
topics.official_english: People's Daily: Labor education should not be done by proxy
topics.why_hot: People's Daily's commentary on treating labor education as something to be outsourced has resonated with parents and educators amid school requirements for practical homework.
topics.share_angle: Use this to explain China's push for school labor education and how parents can teach everyday skills without turning chores into tick-box tasks.

topics.chinese_topic: 多地严查赵一鸣、好想来等
topics.official_english: Multiple regions conduct inspections of snack chains including Zhao Yiming and Haoxianglai
topics.why_hot: Discount snack-food chains are being inspected in several cities, prompting online discussion about food safety, hygiene and rapid franchise expansion.
topics.share_angle: Explain why such low-price snack chains grew so fast, what regulators focus on during inspections, and what consumers should look for.

topics.chinese_topic: 女篮世界杯中国队加时险胜捷克队
topics.official_english: China women's basketball team narrowly beats Czech Republic in overtime at the World Cup
topics.why_hot: China's women's national basketball team won a dramatic overtime game against the Czech Republic, exciting fans and drawing attention to the team's tournament run.
topics.share_angle: Recap the game's decisive moments, the team's key performers, and what this result means for China's next matches in the competition.

topics.chinese_topic: “一吨旧手机提炼200克黄金”不实
topics.official_english: Claim that one ton of old phones can yield 200 grams of gold is untrue
topics.why_hot: A widely repeated figure about gold recovery from old phones was debunked, drawing attention to e-waste recycling and online misinformation.
topics.share_angle: Use the fact-check to explain what can realistically be recovered from e-waste and why phone recycling still matters for the environment.

topics.chinese_topic: 滕王阁 终身免费票
topics.official_english: Tengwangge Pavilion: lifetime free admission sparks interest
topics.why_hot: Reports about a lifetime free-ticket arrangement at the historic Tengwangge Pavilion have drawn attention to how scenic spots use culture to attract tourists.
topics.share_angle: Introduce the cultural significance of Tengwangge and explain how Chinese heritage sites are using poetry, recitation and free-ticket incentives to boost tourism.

topics.official_english: Why people have stopped wearing leather shoes
topics.why_hot: A lifestyle discussion is trending as many people reflect on how sneakers, casual shoes and changing dress codes have pushed leather shoes out of daily life.
topics.share_angle: Look at how workplace culture, sneaker trends and comfort-first fashion have changed wardrobes, and what the shift means for the footwear industry.
